lead: The federal government and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's PTI-led administration traded blame over militancy after a suicide attack in D.I. Khan and a deadly ambush in Tank. The PML-N held Bahawalpur's NA-168 seat, IMF review talks got under way in Islamabad, and heavy rain disrupted the twin cities.

stories.headline: Centre and KP government clash over counter-terror response
stories.summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry accused the PTI-led provincial government of failing to act against militants. KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi replied that the centre's own policy had not worked for two decades and asked for a say in counter-terror strategy.

stories.headline: PML-N holds Bahawalpur seat in NA-168 by-election
stories.summary: PML-N candidate Malik Munir Iqbal Channar won with 79,306 votes, ahead of independent Wali Dad Cheema on 42,623, according to results reported by Geo.

stories.headline: Talk of governor's rule in KP as PTI dares Islamabad
stories.summary: PTI leaders warned that imposing governor's rule would worsen the province's situation, with one proposing assembly resignations and street protests. The Express Tribune reports that governor's rule and an emergency are under consideration.

stories.headline: PTI offers talks again after postponing Islamabad march
stories.summary: The party renewed its offer of dialogue with the government and denied reports of backchannel contacts; the march is now set for 4 October. The M-1 motorway and GT Road between Islamabad and Peshawar have reopened.

stories.headline: Federal ministers criticise KP's new police law
stories.summary: The KP government has approved a Police Act 2026 it describes as a reform package; federal critics say it would hand the provincial government control over the police, BBC Urdu reports. The provincial assembly speaker has also clashed with Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi over the issue.

stories.headline: At least 12 killed in suicide attack on D.I. Khan checkpost
stories.summary: The attack on an anti-smuggling checkpoint in the Darazanda area on Saturday killed women and children among others; Geo puts the toll at 13. Pakistan says an Afghan national was involved, BBC Urdu reports.

stories.headline: Three traffic police officers killed in Tank ambush
stories.summary: Gunmen fired on a traffic police van in Wazirabad Bazaar; two passers-by were also injured, officials said.

stories.headline: Pakistan protests to Kabul over airspace violation
stories.summary: The Foreign Office issued a demarche to the Afghan embassy over what it called a violation of Pakistani airspace last week, after rejecting Taliban claims linking Pakistan to violence in Nuristan.

stories.headline: ISPR says over 70 militants killed in Balochistan
stories.summary: The military said the operations over four days targeted groups it accuses India of backing; the claim could not be independently verified.

stories.headline: IMF review talks for next $1.2bn tranche begin
stories.summary: Formal negotiations with the visiting IMF mission on the fourth review of the $7bn loan programme started in Islamabad.

stories.headline: 25% water shortfall forecast for Rabi season
stories.summary: Reservoir carry-over has fallen to its lowest since 2021, adding pressure on the wheat crop.

stories.headline: PSX drops over 400 points as oil climbs
stories.summary: Early gains reversed as Brent rose more than 3% on the US–Iran stalemate. The rupee edged up to 277.15 to the dollar, while gold fell by Rs12,800 per tola.

stories.headline: Government rules out buying aircraft for privatised PIA
stories.summary: A finance ministry adviser said the state would neither buy planes nor guarantee loans for them.

stories.headline: Sindh irrigation seeks Rs770m for flood work — with no flood
stories.summary: The department is asking for funds for 2025 emergency works; experts question the spending.

stories.headline: Mir Raza inquiry extended to 15 October
stories.summary: Sindh's chief minister approved more time for the judicial commission probing the young businessman's death after its 30-day term ran out.

stories.headline: Rain floods twin cities, diverts flights
stories.summary: Civic bodies in Rawalpindi were put on alert, and flights from Jeddah and Paris were diverted from Islamabad.

stories.headline: Iran says no talks with US are planned
stories.summary: Iranian state media denied new negotiations after President Trump said he expected talks this week.

stories.headline: Pakistani pilots train in China for space mission
stories.summary: Two pilots are preparing for what would be Pakistan's first crewed spaceflight.

stories.headline: Hockey team thrash Oman 7-2 to reach Asian Games semis
stories.summary: Rana Waheed scored a hat-trick.

stories.headline: Rain puts Pakistan and India into cricket semi-finals
stories.summary: Both quarter-finals were washed out, keeping the neighbours on course for a possible final meeting.
